{{Top}}
The '''solar ionization cannon''' was a powerful weapon used by both the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]] on his starship, ''[[Hell's Anvil]]'',<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> and by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] infiltrator, the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']].<ref name="FF5">{{FactFile|5|SIT 1-2|Sith Infiltrator}}</ref> It featured a power hungry, high intensity beam of ionized light that could bypass conventional shields, and melt durasteel.
